# railway_project (Resource)

A Railway project. Destroying this resource permanently deletes the project and everything in it; review the destroy plan carefully.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_project" "example" {
  name                     = "terraform-example"
  description              = "Managed by Terraform"
  is_public                = false
  default_environment_name = "production"
  pr_deploys               = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project display name.

### Optional

- `bot_pr_environments` (Boolean) Enable bot-created PR environments where supported.
- `default_environment_name` (String) Name of the default environment created with the project.
- `description` (String) Project description.
- `focused_pr_environments` (Boolean) Enable focused PR environments where supported.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the project is public.
- `pr_deploys` (Boolean) Enable pull-request deployments.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace in which to create the project.

### Read-Only

- `default_environment_id` (String) ID of Railway's primary/default environment.
- `id` (String) Railway project ID.
